reason: As someone who has been burned by an unfulfilled campaign, Document B earns my trust by stating that the art and rules are 100% finished—avoiding the number one cause of delays—and by doing the exact math on platform fees, shipping for 572 backers, and contingency margin. Document A invents details about who playtested the game and leaves the budget math vague, whereas B proves this first-time creator actually understands the financial realities of fulfillment.
